description: Use when you need to exploit a format string vulnerability on an authorized target, such as a CTF pwn challenge or lab binary that passes user input directly to printf or a similar function. Covers finding the positional parameter offset, reading stack and memory with %x and %s, leaking libc and binary addresses to defeat ASLR and PIE, writing values with %n, and automating exploitation with pwntools 4.13 fmtstr_payload. Use when user input reaches a printf-family function as the format string, or when you need an info leak to enable another exploit primitive.
